records.statement: Coinbase's cbXRP proof-of-reserves page is first-party and dynamic, not an independent audit. Its displayed refresh time is 10/30/2026 1:29 PM without a timezone; the BaseScan contract link returned 403, so supply was not independently read from Base. The 20 displayed address balances reconcile to within 0.002 XRP due to rounding.

Coinbase's digital asset disclosures state holdings as of 31 March 2026 and use a broad 'Commercial Engagement' definition. XRP and cbXRP are marked held/engaged, but no XRP holding amount or specific commercial activity is disclosed; this cannot be treated as a current balance.

The cbXRP reserve/supply totals do not reveal mint/burn history, DeFi collateral utilization, secondary-market depth or net new XRP demand. Coinbase's help page lists regional send/receive restrictions including Japan and New York State, which can change and must be distinguished from native XRP support.
